title: Customer
description: Customer contact information for a consented lead, shared by MCP, A2A and PAP. First and last names and at least one email or E.164 phone number are required. Include only contact information authorized for this submission.

email.description: Customer email address (RFC 5322). At least one of `email` or `phone` MUST be present.

phone.description: Customer phone number in E.164 format (leading '+' and country code, digits only). At least one of `email` or `phone` MUST be present.

preferred_contact.description: Channel preferred for follow-up. 'sms' is treated as text-message via 'phone'.

address.description: Optional postal address (used for residency, registration, or remote delivery).
